description: We are a two-person dev team building a 3D Lunar Landing Site Navigator for The Next Frontier. Using real NASA LRO/LOLA elevation and polar illumination datasets, we combine a Python geospatial pipeline with an interactive Three.js 3D Moon featuring switchable heatmaps for landing suitability, terrain slope, sunlight, and a 29.5-day solar power cycle simulator. Our core duo is set and ready to advance Artemis-era mission planning!
